newsitem.title: USA: CMS Energy acquires stake in gas marketer.
newsitem.headline: CMS Energy acquires stake in gas marketer.

text.p: CMS Energy Corp said it has acquired a 50 percent interest in the assets of Texon Corp and Texon Terminals, a privately held, independent oil and natural gas liquids marketing and gathering business.
Terms of the transasction were not disclosed, but Houston-based Texon had $1 billion in 1996 revenues.
Texon is engaged in purchasing, transporting and marketing oil and natural gas liquids in 25 states in the eastern, central, and Rocky Mountain regions of the United States.
It also markets propane for wholesale customers through its propane terminal facilities in Dexter, Mo., and Lebanon, Ind.
CMS said it and Texon have formed a new partnership, Texon LP, to carry on Texon's oil and natural gas liquids marketing business throughout the United States as well as in overseas markets.

"Teaming up with Texon immediately adds crude oil and petrochemical-based liquids trading capability to our broad array of gas, electric and coal marketing and trading services," said William Schivley, chief operating officer of CMS Marketing, Services and Trading, the company's energy marketing subsidiary.
